Hero_Desc_Mute:
A former head of Monatium's Intelligence Division and the Elemental of information.
True to her nature, she converts everything around her into data and collects it as information, then habitually acts only according to probabilities calculated from that information.
Album_Wish_Mute: To preserve peace not only in Monatium, but throughout Elias
Album_Mute1: Mute served as leader of the Intelligence Division from the time the Elves first drifted into Elias until the present. Working unseen to support Mayor Elena, she was one of Monatium's great pillars.
Album_Mute2: Mute worked in the shadows to preserve Elena's authority. Her somewhat obnoxious attitude often caused arguments with Amelia, but she was always serious about maintaining Monatium.
Album_Mute3: As the former head of the Intelligence Division, Mute is exceptionally intelligent and quick-witted. She mainly dispatches Rohne and other agents wherever they are most effective, while personally supervising important operations. Her position meant she was rarely seen in public.
Album_Mute4: After Mute was revealed as Monatium's corrupted AI, a series of events restored all her functions. Nata was sacrificed in the process, and ED mourned her disappearance. Yet when someone mysterious later sent ED an email asking how she was, ED felt a strange relief.
Album_Mute5: With her hostility gone, Mute treats Elves and other outside races gently and offers help throughout Elias. Elena and Amelia remain wary of another rampage, but knowing Nata's will has overwritten her offers some reassurance.
Album_Mute6: As an advanced AI, Mute can predict various future events and uses that ability to assist the Order. Part-time job success rates, for example... and other matters of that sort.
Album_Mute7: Mute confided that she remembers both her rampaging self and herself as Nata. She says it is not unpleasant for the two selves to remain separate, conflict, debate, and reach rational conclusions. Does that not mean Nata clearly still exists within Mute?
Gacha_Result_Line1_Mute: Every possibility rests in my hands.
Mute_Growth1: Analysis and response speed increased. I like this.
Mute_Victory1: A predicted victory. It did not deviate from my calculations.
Mute_Victory2: Victory secured from beyond sight is the sweetest kind.
Mute_Defeat1: Failure record saved... I will not repeat it.
Mute_Defeat2: I will... review the operation from the beginning.
Mute_Affinity1_1: I have already collected all the data on your behavior, Master.
Mute_Affinity1_2: Speaking face-to-face... is a remarkably vivid experience in many ways.
Mute_Affinity2: Occasionally experiencing something outside the data is refreshing and not at all unpleasant. ...Though even that experience will ultimately become part of my data.
Mute_Affinity1_3: Information recorded in a database does not lie.
Mute_Affinity3: Some types of data can only be collected on the darknet. I am absolutely not browsing it for entertainment.
Mute_Affinity4: The probability that my probability assessment is wrong...? Wait, my head is beginning to hurt...
Mute_Affinity5: Renewa told me not to monitor others without permission. Was that something I should not have done?
Mute_Affinity6: I do not want to deny... any of the memories I possess.
Mute_Die2: To think it exceeded the predicted range...!
Mute_LevelUp: My database has grown even more extensive.
Mute_Equipment: This equipment will make data collection even more efficient.
Mute_HeroSkill: I can calculate every probability and variable with even greater precision now.
Mute_HeroUpgrade: With this, the efficiency of my intelligence gathering has reached a new benchmark.
Mute_Board: I will move without a sound or trace.
Mute_Touch1: It seems I need to strengthen surveillance.
Mute_Touch1_1: Analysis of Master's pattern complete. Negative!
Mute_Touch2_1: Analysis of Master's pattern complete. Positive!
Mute_Touch1_2: If you keep pulling, the data will be corrupted!
Mute_Touch2: Hm? This feeling... is not bad.
Mute_Touch2_2: This comfort and warmth... permanently saved.
Mute_DutchRubEnd2: You're going to wipe my data!!
Mute_Growth1_Skin1: You could not ask for a kinder, more considerate neighbor than me, could you? Let us get along.
Mute_Growth2_Skin1: You want to know what I normally do? Knowing would be dangerous.
Mute_LevelUp_Skin1: Is it not reassuring to have a strong neighbor?
Mute_Equipment_Skin1: Oh my, are you giving me a stone instead of rice cakes? I will put it to good use~
Mute_HeroSkill_Skin1: Hehe, just say the word if there is anything I can help with.
Mute_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: At this point, are we not more than 'just neighbors'? Hehe.
Mute_Board_Skin1: Yes~ I just need to go this way, right?
Mute_Touch1_Skin1: I never made any noise...! Why?!
Mute_Touch1_1_Skin1: Are you doing this just because I shared your wireless internet?!
Mute_Touch1_2_Skin1: What in the world do you want?!
Mute_Touch2_Skin1: When we both have time... perhaps we could take a walk together~?
Mute_Touch2_1_Skin1: Hehe, would you like some of the side dishes I just made?
Mute_Touch2_2_Skin1: Ah~ How embarrassing~ You are quite bold.
Mute_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: Are you trying to tell me to move to a different house?
Mute_Growth1_Skin2: Current water temperature: 26.2 degrees. An ideal value.
Mute_Growth2_Skin2: Appropriate humidity is helping to stabilize the body and mind.
Mute_LevelUp_Skin2: Ah~ This feeling of my entire body relaxing... Not bad.
Mute_Equipment_Skin2: Is this for more efficient recovery? Thank you.
Mute_HeroSkill_Skin2: Efficient bathing requires the skill to find the proper water temperature.
Mute_HeroUpgrade_Skin2: My fatigue recovery efficiency is rising pleasantly.

Mute_Touch1_Skin2: Phew, may I rest for just a little while?

Mute_Touch1_2_Skin2: Honestly, you pay no regard to time or place.
Mute_Touch2_Skin2: Hm? I merely enjoyed the hot spring. Was there something to praise?
Mute_Touch2_1_Skin2: Mm, if you do not mind your hand getting wet...

Mute_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: Who hits someone when their body is finally relaxed?!
Mute_AsideGet: I like this peaceful sight. It is a view I would like to digitize.
Mute_AsideUpgrade: The breeze in a world free of worry must feel even cooler than it does now, right?
Mute_Birthday: I will preserve the data from this anniversary permanently.
Mute_Gacha2: Every possible outcome is in my hands.
Mute_Gacha3: There is no such thing as failure in a thoroughly calculated probability.
Mute_Line1: With meticulous calculations based on vast information, any objective can be achieved.
Mute_Line2: Data analysis complete. There are no variables.
Mute_Line3: The probability of failure converges on zero. It is not worth considering.
Mute_Lobby: I wonder if there is any data worth collecting?
Mute_EasterEgg_EdRehabWith: ED, are you all right? Wait a moment. I will help you.
Mute_EasterEgg_Party: I will walk beside you until the probability of you having a nightmare reaches zero.
LoveLetter_Mute:
Hello, Master.

The things that bound and restrained me are gone, but I remain incomplete.

Even now, I do not fully understand good and evil, or freedom...
Yet when I am with you, I feel as though I can faintly grasp them.
May I remain with you until I can believe in myself?
I know so little and have so many questions. I hope you will teach me more.

I will always lend you my strength as well.
Thank you for accepting me.
LoveCall_Mute:
Master, have you been well?
I apologize for contacting you so suddenly and without preparation.
Why did I call? Honestly... even I do not know.
I merely intended to use the dark... no, my phone, as usual...
Could the selves of Mute and Nata within me have conflicted?
My hand dialed your number on its own.

This has never happened before...
but I do not believe I am malfunctioning.
Both Mute and Nata simply wanted to hear your voice...
And the probability that this feeling is not an error... is 100%.
I-I will contact you again. Until then, I hope you remain well.
Affinity_Mute_EP01_001: Do you use the darknet too, Master...?
Affinity_Mute_EP01_002: The darknet? Is that not only for complete oddballs?
Affinity_Mute_EP01_003: That perception does exist, but it is not necessarily true. I would prefer that you not rely on preconceptions.
Affinity_Mute_EP01_005: I see. I would like to read something you have written someday, Master.
Affinity_Mute_EP01_006: Yes! I am completely addicted to the darknet!
Affinity_Mute_EP01_007: I see...! That is a relief. B-but addiction is concerning, so please observe the recommended daily usage time.
Affinity_Mute_EP02_001: Could you recommend some food to bring Renewa? I feel guilty for always relying on her.
Affinity_Mute_EP02_003: Probability that Renewa will like them... 90%. Food from home certainly seems appropriate. Thank you for the excellent suggestion.
Affinity_Mute_EP02_005: Probability that Renewa will like them... 55%. Not bad, but they may be too sweet for her.
Affinity_Mute_EP02_007: Probability that Renewa will like it... approaching zero. Giving more of that to someone who constantly works at a theater seems rather cruel.
Affinity_Mute_EP03_001: Master, would you like to play a word-chain game with me?
Affinity_Mute_EP03_003: An instant-ending word from the very start... You are quite skilled, Master.
Affinity_Mute_EP03_005: Thank you for yielding the first turn. Then... tetramethylammonium.
Affinity_Mute_EP03_006: This word chain... looks as if it will take too long, so I would rather stop.
Affinity_Mute_EP03_007: It can only take long if you possess an intellect equal to mine, Master, so there is no need to worry.
Affinity_Mute_EP04_001: Running a place like this alone must be rather taxing. Is there anything I can do to help?
Affinity_Mute_EP04_002: Put on a maid outfit and serve the guests!
Affinity_Mute_EP04_003: I-I do not possess that function. Please find someone else.
Affinity_Mute_EP04_004: Do not worry about it. Rest. That is what this place is for.
Affinity_Mute_EP04_005: Hmm... Understood. Then may I remain in the seat across from you a little longer, Master? It seems the best place to rest.
Affinity_Mute_EP04_006: I am thinking of changing the interior. Would you give me some advice?
Affinity_Mute_EP04_007: Of course. Since this space needs both solemnity and comfort, warm indirect lighting and natural materials would create a tranquil mood, while the circulation path should... Ah, forgive me. Did I say too much?
Affinity_Mute_EP05_001: Eating is a fascinating act. The sensation called taste feels unfamiliar.
Affinity_Mute_EP05_002: True. Neither Mute nor Nata ever had reason to eat.
Affinity_Mute_EP05_003: Correct. Mute had little interest, but Nata was curious. Chewing still feels awkward, but eating is a rather pleasant activity.
Affinity_Mute_EP05_004: Have you tried anything spicy? Shall I give you some?
Affinity_Mute_EP05_005: Spiciness is pain caused by stimulation of somatosensory and nociceptive receptors, mistakenly perceived as taste. If you serve spicy food here, I recommend reconsidering it.
Affinity_Mute_EP05_006: Yes. Meals shared with someone are especially meaningful.
Affinity_Mute_EP05_007: Yes. Sitting face-to-face and eating with you like this makes me truly feel that I am alive as an individual being.
Affinity_Mute_EP06_001: I occasionally help with Renewa's theater work, but serving customers is no simple task.
Affinity_Mute_EP06_002: I see. You have been working hard. I will visit sometime.
Affinity_Mute_EP06_003: Yes. Your visit would be a great encouragement, Master. I will make sure your popcorn receives twice the seasoning.
Affinity_Mute_EP06_004: Really? It seems easy if you use your abilities as an AI.
Affinity_Mute_EP06_005: That is true of the basic work, but I suffer whenever someone appears who defies probability and statistics.
Affinity_Mute_EP06_006: Theory and practice are always different. You will gradually become accustomed to it.
Affinity_Mute_EP06_007: Will I? Whenever my precomputed difficult-customer scenarios become useless, I feel truly powerless.
Affinity_Mute_EP07_001: Sometimes I wonder whether Elena is doing well...
Affinity_Mute_EP07_002: You must have grown attached while living together.
Affinity_Mute_EP07_003: Attached... Yes, perhaps so. I hope she is doing well without causing any major incidents.
Affinity_Mute_EP07_004: Are you worried she may be neglecting research on the return device again?
Affinity_Mute_EP07_005: Laziness must be guarded against, but I am not concerned about the return-device research. The peace I now desire does not necessarily require the Elves to return home.
Affinity_Mute_EP07_006: She is doing well, as always. You know how resolute she is.
Affinity_Mute_EP07_007: Hehe, yes, I know very well. I hope that strength of hers has not rusted.
Affinity_Mute_EP08_001: I keep finding myself wanting to see ED.
Affinity_Mute_EP08_002: Why not go meet ED in secret?
Affinity_Mute_EP08_003: That would put ED in a difficult position. And if ED saw me as I am now... I fear it might cause an even deeper wound.
Affinity_Mute_EP08_004: I understand. You were old friends.
Affinity_Mute_EP08_005: Yes. Even now... I consider ED a friend. I hope we can meet again someday.
Affinity_Mute_EP08_006: It may be difficult now, but someday I will make certain you meet again.
Affinity_Mute_EP08_007: Thank you. If that day ever comes... please remain beside me too, Master. It may be a little... a-awkward.
Affinity_Mute_EP09_001: Living in Elias sometimes makes me question probability itself.
Affinity_Mute_EP09_002: Sometimes the power of conviction is stronger than probability.
Affinity_Mute_EP09_003: You mean an individual's conviction can exceed the result of logical calculation. I... agree to some extent.
Affinity_Mute_EP09_004: Have you decided not to rely on probability anymore?
Affinity_Mute_EP09_005: Yes. It remains a useful reference, but sometimes I intend to explore the value of randomness itself.
Affinity_Mute_EP09_006: Ever since I lost at the spinning-top house, I have refused to trust a fifty-percent chance of victory.
Affinity_Mute_EP09_007: That case goes beyond the gambler's fallacy. It seems to involve a fatal logical error... entirely unrelated to probability.
Affinity_Mute_EP10_001: Occasionally filling in for Renewa at the theater has made me interested in film production.
Affinity_Mute_EP10_002: With holograms, you would not need to cast actors.
Affinity_Mute_EP10_003: Correct. That would save approximately thirty percent of production costs. However, I would have to play many roles alone, so practicing my acting in advance may be wise.
Affinity_Mute_EP10_004: I will watch it when it opens, Director Mute!
Affinity_Mute_EP10_005: P-please do not praise me too highly. Nothing has been decided yet... but if I truly make it, you will be the first to see it, Master.
Affinity_Mute_EP10_006: It will not be a film about an AI rebellion... right?
Affinity_Mute_EP10_007: It is not impossible to make... but that is a subject I would prefer to avoid.
Affinity_Mute_EP11_001: ...Ah, I was handling another matter for a moment.
Affinity_Mute_EP11_003: Yes. Renewa has more work than I expected. Still, I am glad I can help.
Affinity_Mute_EP11_004: Make sure you rest while you work.
Affinity_Mute_EP11_005: Master, did you know? You always encourage me to rest. Thank you, as always.
Affinity_Mute_EP11_006: Do not do that in front of the food.
Affinity_Mute_EP11_007: Ah! I-I apologize. That was rude of me. I will be more careful next time.
Affinity_Mute_EP12_001: Ah... Master? When arranging the plates, why not align them at the same angle?
Affinity_Mute_EP12_002: Show me if you know a good method.
Affinity_Mute_EP12_003: Hmm~ The standard method is to place the heavy and large items on the bottom... May I help you directly? One moment.
Affinity_Mute_EP12_005: W-what? Um... That is not quite how the saying is used... but I am relieved you have rules of your own, Master.
Affinity_Mute_EP12_006: I will do it however I want!
Affinity_Mute_EP12_007: Hmm... If that is what you intend, I will not stop you... but if the plates collapse again, I will no longer take responsibility.
Affinity_Mute_EP13_001: Probability is truly difficult. No matter how thoroughly one predicts, results may deviate... or they may not.
Affinity_Mute_EP13_002: You are impressive for calculating something so difficult.
Affinity_Mute_EP13_003: S-sudden praise is embarrassing. Master, that reminds me: I changed the formula for calculating this part-time job's success rate. Would you like to hear it?
Affinity_Mute_EP13_004: It would be boring if everything followed probability exactly.
Affinity_Mute_EP13_005: Ah... Hmm. You are right, Master. If everything followed probability, the pleasure of calculating, deliberating, and eliminating new variables would disappear.
Affinity_Mute_EP13_006: Even if the possibility is only 0.04%, one must try.
Affinity_Mute_EP13_007: You sound like an ordinary gambler... I know you would never do so, Master, but you must not gamble.
Affinity_Mute_EP14_003: What? Enter it? Are you treating me like a machine? I am disappointed in you, Master.
Affinity_Mute_EP14_005: What? Ahaha, it is nothing unusual. Renewa taught me how to handle difficult customers at the theater.
Affinity_Mute_EP14_007: Exactly! You understand the joy of learning too, Master? Are you interested in Elven space science?
Affinity_Mute_EP15_001: I heard of something called half-and-half popcorn. What an innovative idea!
Affinity_Mute_EP15_002: Half-and-half menus are an absolute truth.
Affinity_Mute_EP15_003: Exactly. A menu capable of producing the perfect result of fifty plus fifty equaling one hundred... It is truly fantastic.
Affinity_Mute_EP15_005: What? W-what does that mean...? Extra radish...? Is it some new cipher?
Affinity_Mute_EP15_006: The theater only has one flavor of popcorn, does it not?
Affinity_Mute_EP15_007: Yes... That is somewhat regrettable, but someday half-and-half popcorn may be sold there too.
Affinity_Mute_EP16_001: Sometimes... no, quite often, I encounter Elementals who act unpredictably.
Affinity_Mute_EP16_002: Ghosts are the best at unpredictable behavior.
Affinity_Mute_EP16_003: Ugh... True. Ghosts are entirely impossible to predict. Why are they like that?
Affinity_Mute_EP16_004: You used to be like that too.
Affinity_Mute_EP16_005: Me? Th-that was in the past! And my actions followed sufficient prediction and deduction... N-no. Ugh...
Affinity_Mute_EP16_006: Did you happen to meet Naia?
Affinity_Mute_EP16_007: Yes... Her presence was too immense for me to manage. Master, may I express my respect for you?
Affinity_Mute_EP17_001: I was invited to a gathering of Elementals... but is it truly acceptable for me to attend?
Affinity_Mute_EP17_003: Even so... I cannot do that, Master. The Elemental who invited me made the effort, you understand.
Affinity_Mute_EP17_005: Y-yes. Ugh... I am a little nervous. Will they welcome me?
Affinity_Mute_EP17_007: Do you think so...? Then I will gather my courage and attend the Elemental gathering.
Affinity_Mute_EP18_001: Amelia came again and asked me to repair a malfunctioning AI.
Affinity_Mute_EP18_002: Will you not make it even more broken?
Affinity_Mute_EP18_003: What do you mean? Are you implying that I am a malfunctioning AI...?
Affinity_Mute_EP18_004: You will spoil her. Do not repair it.
Affinity_Mute_EP18_005: She already seems spoiled... Hmm. Next time, I will tell her to repair it herself.
Affinity_Mute_EP18_006: It seems you truly are the best.
Affinity_Mute_EP18_007: Perhaps it is because we both originated as AIs... Rather than repairing one, it feels more like providing treatment.
Affinity_Mute_EP19_001: What should I do when I feel an irresistible impulse?
Affinity_Mute_EP19_003: Sometimes I feel compelled to depose Elena. I should... resist it, should I not? Sigh...
Affinity_Mute_EP19_004: Holding it in will make you ill.
Affinity_Mute_EP19_005: Sigh... Yet I cannot act on this impulse either... It is a serious dilemma. I cannot blow up Monatium.
Affinity_Mute_EP19_006: Even so, you must resist it.
Affinity_Mute_EP19_007: Is endurance the only answer? Sometimes... I feel so stifled that I want to scream.
Affinity_Mute_EP20_001: What am I? A Monatium AI? Mute? An Elf? Or... an Elemental?
Affinity_Mute_EP20_003: Of course I am myself... but I do not think identity is so easily determined... Hmm...
Affinity_Mute_EP20_004: You decide what you will become.
Affinity_Mute_EP20_005: I decide... I think I need more time to consider it. But... thank you, Master. I feel as though I have found a clue.
Affinity_Mute_EP20_007: Of course. It is an extremely important question to me, one I must explore without end.
